text: The command SHALL scan and analyze either active changes or specs based on the selected mode.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution

text: When `openspec list` is executed without flags, scan the `openspec/changes/` directory for change directories.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution › Scenario: Scanning for changes (default) › THEN[1]

text: When `openspec list` is executed without flags, exclude the `archive/` subdirectory from results.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution › Scenario: Scanning for changes (default) › AND[2]

text: When `openspec list` is executed without flags, parse each change's `tasks.md` file to count task completion.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution › Scenario: Scanning for changes (default) › AND[3]

text: When `openspec list --specs` is executed, scan the `openspec/specs/` directory for capabilities.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution › Scenario: Scanning for specs › THEN[1]

text: When `openspec list --specs` is executed, read each capability's `spec.md`.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution › Scenario: Scanning for specs › AND[2]

text: When `openspec list --specs` is executed, parse requirements to compute requirement counts.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Command Execution › Scenario: Scanning for specs › AND[3]

text: The command SHALL accurately count task completion status using standard markdown checkbox patterns.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Task Counting

text: When parsing a `tasks.md` file, count tasks matching these patterns: Completed: Lines containing `- [x]` Incomplete: Lines containing `- [ ]`.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Task Counting › Scenario: Counting tasks in tasks.md › THEN[1]

text: When parsing a `tasks.md` file, calculate total tasks as the sum of completed and incomplete.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Task Counting › Scenario: Counting tasks in tasks.md › AND[2]

text: The command SHALL display items in a clear, readable table format with mode-appropriate progress or counts.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Output Format

text: When displaying the list of changes, show a table with columns: Change name (directory name) Task progress (e.g., "3/5 tasks" or "✓ Complete").
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Output Format › Scenario: Displaying change list (default) › THEN[1]

text: When displaying the list of specs, show a table with columns: Spec id (directory name) Requirement count (e.g., "requirements 12").
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Output Format › Scenario: Displaying spec list › THEN[1]

text: The command SHALL accept flags to select the noun being listed.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Flags

text: When `--specs` is provided, list specs instead of changes.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Flags › Scenario: Selecting specs › THEN[1]

text: When `--changes` is provided, list changes explicitly (same as default behavior).
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Flags › Scenario: Selecting changes › THEN[1]

text: The command SHALL provide clear feedback when no items are present for the selected mode.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Empty State

text: When no active changes exist (only archive/ or empty changes/), display: "No active changes found.".
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Empty State › Scenario: Handling empty state (changes) › THEN[1]

text: When no specs directory exists or contains no capabilities, display: "No specs found.".
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Empty State › Scenario: Handling empty state (specs) › THEN[1]

text: The command SHALL gracefully handle missing files and directories with appropriate messages.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Error Handling

text: When a change directory has no `tasks.md` file, display the change with "No tasks" status.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Error Handling › Scenario: Missing tasks.md file › THEN[1]

text: When `openspec/changes/` directory doesn't exist, display error: "No OpenSpec changes directory found. Run 'openspec init' first.".
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Error Handling › Scenario: Missing changes directory › THEN[1]

text: When `openspec/changes/` directory doesn't exist, exit with code 1.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Error Handling › Scenario: Missing changes directory › AND[2]

text: The command SHALL maintain consistent ordering of changes for predictable output.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Sorting

text: When displaying multiple changes, sort them in alphabetical order by change name.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Sorting › Scenario: Ordering changes › THEN[1]
